text:
maya: quick sync: propose mandatory 72h checkpoint for P1s + a one-line 7d follow-up. stop postmortem tickets from going cold.
owen: yes. require an owner + ETA at 72h. no owner -> auto-escalate to oncall lead.
tara: keep template tiny so teams adopt it. suggestion: fields: checkpoint, owner, status, next_step, blockers, related_count.
leo: rotation idea: weekly IC rotation but incoming IC must be acked by outgoing IC with `!handoff` command that posts a 3-bullet context card.
oncall-bot: mock: will DM owner at 72h and 7d, and post reminder in thread if no update after 30m. automation PR needed. :robot_face:
maya: pilot plan: 4 teams for 6 weeks. metrics: percent of actions without owner at 72h, median time-to-remediate, recurrence_count. if pilot works, add 72h checkpoint as closure gate on board.
owen: i'll make the board lane. tara: i'll draft the tiny RFC and template. leo: i'll prototype the `!handoff` command.
maya: thanks all, will tag reviewers when RFC is up. :thumbsup:
